segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report smaller-looking pores, reduced oiliness, and generally good tolerance, including one who calls it a holy grail for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report improved texture and hydration, though one with dry skin describes clogged pores and small textured pimples with this formula and prefers a lower-percentage niacinamide product.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report reduced pore size and good results, including one using it alongside a partner with very dry skin with success for both.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several call it their holy grail with no bad breakouts, while others report severe redness, burning, hives, or a rash serious enough to stop use.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s with oily skin and one addressing fine lines and sagging report visibly smaller pores and firmer-looking skin.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal-to-dry skin and acne scars reports the product is very effective but too strong for daily use, reserving it for weekly treatment to protect the skin barrier.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines, sagging, or general aging report tighter-looking, smoother skin; no dissent noted on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report increased hydration and smoother, plumper-looking skin, often pairing it with a moisturizer or hyaluronic acid serum; one dry-skin reviewer instead reports clogged pores and small pimples.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, including those with rosacea, report visibly reduced redness and eveler tone over weeks of use; one sensitive, redness-prone reviewer reports the opposite, with immediate intense burning redness that did not resolve.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin and acne scars reports strong results but limits use to weekly out of concern for barrier tolerance; another reports needing a lower-strength niacinamide after this one proved too strong.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots and acne marks with consistent use over weeks to months, with a couple noting it takes patience; no reviewer reports spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster resolution of new pimples, and cleared blemishes over time; however, several separate reviewers report new breakouts, whiteheads, small textured pimples, or a hive-like rash after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the product helps balance oil and reduce shine; one long-term user specifically credits it with reducing oiliness after a year of use.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin that is redness prone and have been very cautious about what products I use. I've had good experiences though with other Good Molecules products, including the Niacinimide toner, so was excited to try this. I have been using the toner for several months and am on my second bottle. It's never caused a bad reaction or irritation and seemed to be slowly faded dark spots from sun damage and age. I was hoping this serum would fade those spots more quickly. Immediately after using this serum my face turned neon red, like I had a bad sunburn. The skin even felt hot. It stayed that way for a couple of hours. I tried using it three times but every time my face turned bright red and felt like it was burning. There's no way I can use this product. Bummer. This is why I have been a super minimalist when it comes to skincare products and afraid to use stuff because so many products on the market irritate my skin. I thought Good Molecules was a holy grail but this serum apparently is not for me. I guess judging by these reviews it must work for some people but the niacinimide concentration in this is way too high for my skin. I will try their Discoloration serum instead, but otherwise just stick with the toner since I can tolerate that well.

unfortunately I used this for over a year , it really only helped with oilyness , I switched over to the discoloration serum which has 4% niacinamide in it which my skin can tolerate better . I find that this didn't help with acne vs discoloration did plus fading acne marks from cystic acne . I would say if you have very oily skin and large pores try it but do a patch test first. it broke me out due to how strong it was after switching over to discoloration . hope it helps !

extraits.titre: Extremely effective, but not suitable for daily use
extraits.texte: I have normal to dry skin with some acne scars (late 20s / early 30s skin). I used this as directed once in the evening after cleansing and with a face oil after. It was extremely effective, by the morning my skin was extremely smooth. I will not try to use it daily as directed because I do not trust my skin barrier to handle it. Instead I will use it as a weekly treatment.

I purchased this product after doing research on what would help my rosacea. I was desperate to find something that would ACTUALLY work. I read many reviews on different niacinamide serums and this one seemed like the best option. Before purchasing, I'd already made an appointment with a derm to ensure I was doing things right, not damaging my skin more… unfortunately the derm focused on my "acne," ignoring my main concern. I was told by them to stop using all products and only use moisturizer and sunscreen. Welllll, I didn't listen. While I did stop use of all other products, I continued using this serum. Its been about 5 or so weeks now but I didn't realize what a HUGE difference it had made with my rosacea, until I had a flare up just now. My skin is looking amazing, definitely minimizing redness and evening out my skintone. My routine is now cleanse > this serum > Peach Slices all in one oil free moisturizer > sunscreen. As someone who has struggled with rosacea and an uneven skintone for 10+ years, I am so thankful for this product. I'm not one to write reviews, and I'm typically skeptical of skincare products… but I figured if this could help me when I was desperate, I'm sure it could help someone else. I'll leave photo reviews soon.

It has slightly reduced overall skin redness. Reduced flare ups of cystic acne. Overall, really improved skin texture. If i stop using it, the bumps and cystic pimples start coming back. I have oily skin i apply this once a day usually in the morning followed by gel moisturizer with aloe

I have a combination skin type and my partner has extremely dry skin. It has worked super well for both of us, and I've definitely noticed a difference in my usually large pore size. I just bought my second bottle!
